title: Tunisian Grilled Chestnut Salad
description: A flavorful and refreshing salad featuring grilled chestnuts, perfect for a light vegan meal.
instructions: Grill the chestnuts for 5-7 minutes on each side, until they're tender and slightly charred.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.
Add the chopped cilantro to the bowl and toss to combine.
Once the chestnuts are cool enough to handle, slice them in half and add them to the bowl.
Add the grilled red onion to the bowl and toss everything together.
Season with salt to taste and serve.
